errors.text_span: Общата оста Y е обозначена като „Общо наети лица“
errors.evidence: The chart title is "Общо наети лица" (Total Employed Persons), but the Y-axis itself is not labeled.
The chart does not specify that the units on the Y-axis are in thousands; this is an assumption.

errors.text_span: Общата оста X е обозначена като „Година и тримесечие“
errors.evidence: The X-axis is not labeled. "Година и тримесечие" (Year and quarter) is a description of the tick mark labels, not an axis label.
The line starts at a value significantly lower than 2600, approximately at 2350.

errors.text_span: и достига максимум от около 2800 в 2008Q1
errors.evidence: The maximum value shown in the chart is just under 3000 (around 2980), not 2800. The peak also occurs in 2008Q2, not 2008Q1.
The value in 2010Q4 is visibly above 2500, at approximately 2550.

errors.text_span: варираща се между 2550 и 2750 в период от 2011Q1 до 2013Q4
errors.evidence: The actual range of values in this period is approximately 2520 to 2650. The stated range of 2550-2750 is inaccurate.
The line never drops below 2500 after 2010. The value in 2017Q4 is approximately 2700.

errors.text_span: През 2018Q1 стойността се покачва до около 2650
errors.evidence: The value in 2018Q1 is around 2750, not 2650.

errors.text_span: остава стабилна, варираща се между 2600 и 2700 до 2021Q4
errors.evidence: This range is incorrect and completely misses the significant secondary peak that reaches approximately 2900 in 2019.
